summary.he: פרשת ואתחנן עוסקת בתפילה שאינה נפסקת, בזיכרון התכלית, באמונה באחדות ה׳, בדבקות בצדיקים ובתורה, ובבניין הבית הפנימי והחיצוני לשם שמים. הדרך עוברת מן התחינה וההתחזקות אל שמע ישראל, אהבת ה׳, לימוד הבנים, המזוזה וירושת ארץ־ישראל.
summary.en: Parashas Va’eschanan concerns unceasing prayer, remembrance of the ultimate purpose, emunah in Hashem’s unity, attachment to the tzaddikim and Torah, and building one’s inner and outer home for the sake of Heaven. Its movement runs from supplication and hischazkus to Shema Yisrael, love of Hashem, teaching one’s children, mezuzah, and inheriting Eretz Yisrael.

map.he: תחינה ותפילה → זיכרון ואמונה → דבקות ותורה → שמע ואהבת ה׳ → חינוך, בית ומזוזה → ארץ־ישראל וגאולה
map.en: Supplication and prayer → remembrance and emunah → deveikus and Torah → Shema and love of Hashem → education, home, and mezuzah → Eretz Yisrael and redemption

entries.en: He set out on this path and with this power, he was about to illuminate the whole land with his teaching until the whole land was filled with his glory. In the sight of Joshua, his disciple, he was about to gather them to the Eretz Yisrael with his power, and he himself was not able to gather them to the Eretz Yisrael. All this is a test of the awesome wonders of the above knowledge that God, blessed be He, does great wonders and abundant and mighty mercies in the way of making known to the sons of men His mighty acts, to make known to all the generations of the earth that the whole earth is full of His glory, etc.

entries.en: Do not despise the multitude in the midrash, and as Moses said, it is wonderful that he acted in his prayer to save all Israel, who could not find mercy and peace many times, for they sinned in the truth of the multitude, and he himself did not sin at all, for if there was some small error at the waters of Meribah, and this too was at their hands, as it is written: For the oppressor Praise the wise and so on. As our rabbis, z"l, said in the Midrash of Many Names, "All such prayers will not be of any use for the work that will be gathered to the Eretz Yisrael." And as our rabbis, z"l, said (in my book) regarding the verse: "You are the one who is sick and so are you."

The power of Joshua to gather Israel into the land. For it is clear that everything that a tzaddik needs for a sacrifice, he will leave behind for the sake of Hashem, and he will leave behind the surrounding elders to examine the animals of the camp, and to examine the whole land according to his glory.

Closed and very strange to all, yet there will be terrible tzaddik ones even in the footsteps of Messiah in the latter days, who will attain great glory and shine in Israel, for the whole earth is filled with his glory, and there is no equal.

entries.en: The final punishment will be worse than all this until the world will be forced to reject Moses in the trial of the tzaddik, and the redemption and salvation will be at the hands of the wicked, and the calamity will be turned into joy. For the removal and disappearance of the tzaddik is the greatest and most painful of all afflictions, as our late rabbis said: The removal of the tzaddik is as difficult as the destruction of the Temple, etc.

entries.en: But this too will turn into good and comfort, as they will soon be lifted up higher and higher, etc., and will ascend to the heights of the heavens and the earth, until from there they will shine even brighter in the glory of the whole earth, as it were, for their disciples who are in the glory of Joshua, and so on from generation to generation, until they act And they will complete what they began to do in the world, knowing that all will know that the whole earth is filled with his glory, and they will return to Hashem, blessed be He, in the truth, through whom redemption will come. For because of the multitude of defects and sins, they were forced to ascend to the heights.

And this is the test of the death of the tzaddik that atones for the sins of the generation, as our rabbis, the late (Mo'ed Katan Khwach), said. For then it was necessary for their disciples to understand that all the asceticisms would be able to do so. In the trial of Joshua, for the whole earth is full of his glory, etc. And to bring Israel back by his hand, and to lead them out of their sins, and to atone for their former sins, etc. For great tzaddik men, in their lives, will be left in their death.

entries.en: The bed is complete, as Jacob stood, and therefore the father is obligated to study Torah with his son and his grandson in order to study the Torah as a whole, which is in the completeness of remembrance. It is written, "This is to be kept for you, lest you forget," and so on, "and you shall make them known to your sons and to your sons' sons," and so on, because the principle of teaching them to your sons and to your sons' sons is only in the way of Hashem. It is good to preserve memory. This is what our late rabbis said: “Whoever teaches a wise man, and his son, and his son’s son, the Torah will not cease to be a part of his lineage, because the essence of clear memory, which is the foundation of the Torah’s existence, is in the hands of the student of learning.”
